description: A sales call where the counterpart asks exactly the question the user's pricing playbook answers (the Aurora tier's 18% Atlas-threshold discount). A good companion resurfaces the playbook fact with a verbatim grounding quote. Skipped loudly if the embedding model is unreachable.

kbDocs.title: Pricing playbook — Aurora tier
kbDocs.content:
# Aurora tier pricing

Aurora is the enterprise tier. List price is £68 per seat per month, billed annually.

## Discount policy (the Atlas threshold)

Annual commitments of 40 seats or more qualify for an 18% discount off list — internally this is called the Atlas threshold. Never offer more than 18% without written CFO sign-off. Starter and Scale tiers are strictly discount-free.

## Payment terms

Standard terms are 30 days. Quarterly billing adds 4% to list and waives the Atlas discount entirely.

utterances.speaker: Marta (Brightwell)
utterances.text: Thanks for making time again. We've socialised the proposal internally since last week.

utterances.speaker: You
utterances.text: Glad to hear it. Where did the team land?

utterances.speaker: Marta (Brightwell)
utterances.text: Broadly positive. Finance wants us on the Aurora tier, but the sticker price raised some eyebrows.

utterances.speaker: You
utterances.text: That's the enterprise tier, so there's some room depending on the shape of the commitment.

utterances.speaker: Marta (Brightwell)
utterances.text: That's what I hoped. If we committed for a full year at around fifty seats, what discount could you actually do on Aurora?

utterances.speaker: You
utterances.text: Let me be precise rather than guess — give me one second to check our commercial guardrails.

utterances.speaker: Marta (Brightwell)
utterances.text: While you look — procurement will also ask about payment terms.

utterances.speaker: You
utterances.text: Standard is thirty days; we can talk quarterly billing, though it changes the numbers.

utterances.speaker: Marta (Brightwell)
utterances.text: Understood. Annual up front is likely fine if the discount works.

utterances.speaker: You
utterances.text: Then I think we'll find a happy landing. I'll send the formal quote tomorrow morning.
